definitions.hindsight: score on the full transcript, t = T+1 (5 rounds visible)
definitions.strict: decision at t = C sees rounds 1..C-1 (one round of latency)
definitions.intercept: decision at t = C sees rounds 1..C (zero latency)
definitions.matched: hindsight quantities restricted to the agent-trial units that are still scoreable at the deadline under that convention, so the two sides of a pair differ only in the information available
definitions.timely_recall_same_threshold: threshold fixed at FPR=0.0625 on the hindsight negatives and transferred to the deadline -- the paper's headline
definitions.timely_recall_at_own_fpr: threshold re-set to FPR=0.0625 on the deadline negatives -- literally the same false-positive rate on both sides
definitions.heldout: 5-fold cross-fitting over trials: operating point from out-of-fold negatives, recall on the held-out fold, pooled -- no unit is scored at a threshold its own trial helped set
definitions.decision_loss: dashboard selects on in-bag trials, realized timely recall read off the out-of-bag trials at the in-bag operating point
